transcript: Speaker A: I'm a digital ghostwriter and I stopped using my keyboard last week. [Shows laptop] Do a deep research on a YouTube video and ideate three content angles. I can think and speak faster than I can type. Now I can walk and get content written. Whisperflow saves me 5 to 6 hours a week on admin tasks. You can speak 3-4 times faster than you type, so download Whisperflow, it's free to try.
on_screen_text: Ali Abdaal showed me this Ai voice to text productivity hack...Am I cheating? *Secret client*
summary: A content creator demonstrates how Whisperflow, an AI voice-to-text tool, saves him hours by letting him dictate prompts instead of typing. He highlights its efficiency and invites viewers to try it for free.
